import zipfile, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
names = z.namelist()
print('zip entries:', names)
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('{%s}si' % NS):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t' % NS))
        shared.append(text)
print('shared strings:', shared)
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets = wb.find('{%s}sheets' % NS)
for s in sheets:
    print('sheet:', s.get('name'), s.get('sheetId'))
for p in ['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml', 'xl/worksheets/sheet2.xml', 'xl/worksheets/sheet3.xml']:
    if p in names:
        print('=== ' + p + ' ===')
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(p))
        for c in root.iter('{%s}c' % NS):
            ref = c.get('r'); t = c.get('t')
            v = c.find('{%s}v' % NS)
            val = v.text if v is not None else ''
            if t == 's' and val != '':
                val = shared[int(val)]
            print(ref, repr(val))
"
